rationale: Monotonic decreasing curve: injects Q at low voltage (0.93-0.94 pu, q=+0.5) to mitigate sag, zero Q at nominal (1.0 pu), absorbs Q at high voltage (1.07-1.08 pu, q=-0.5) to mitigate swell. At t_low with 0.94 pu base and 80 kvar capability, q=+0.5 gives +40 kvar injection, raising voltage by 0.028 pu to 0.968 pu (within [0.95,1.05]). At t_high with 1.07 pu base, q=-0.5 gives -40 kvar absorption, lowering voltage by 0.028 pu to 1.042 pu (within limits). All q_fraction values within inverter capability for each timestep.
